high_level_description: The image depicts two individuals sitting closely together on a black leather couch with orange cushions. The person on the left is wearing a red and white checkered dress with a graphic design on it, and they have blonde hair. They are leaning back slightly, resting their head on the arm of the couch and their hand on their chin. The person on the right is wearing a gray t-shirt with a graphic print and denim shorts. They have long brown hair tied back and are leaning towards the other person, resting their arm on them.
